low.why: Target verb 'are' translated as 'كذلك', obscuring grammar rule.

low.vi: My father = he nên phải là works, phần sai là (B). Các phần còn lại đúng.
low.en: My father = he, so it must be works; the wrong part is (B). The other parts are correct.
low.l1: أبي = هو، فلا بد من الأعمال؛ الجزء الخطأ هو (ب). والأجزاء الأخرى صحيحة.
low.back: Dad = he, so there must be actions; the wrong part is (b). The other parts are correct.
low.why: Wrong translation: 'actions' instead of 'works'.

low.vi: My sister = she → walk thêm -s thành walks.
low.en: My sister = she → walk takes -s and becomes walks.
low.l1: أختي = هي → المشي يأخذ -s ويصبح يمشي.
low.back: My sister = she → walking takes -s and becomes walks.
low.why: Target English words 'walk' and 'walks' must stay in English.

low.vi: My sister là một người (ngôi thứ ba số ít) → is. am chỉ đi với I; are đi với you, we, they và danh từ số nhiều; be là nguyên mẫu, không đứng ngay sau chủ ngữ.
low.en: "My sister" is one person (third person singular) → is. Am goes only with I; are goes with you, we, they and plural nouns; be is the base form and never comes straight after a subject.
low.l1: "أختي" هي شخص واحد (ضمير الغائب المفرد) → هو. أنا أذهب معي فقط؛ يذهب معك، نحن، هم وأسماء الجمع؛ be هو النموذج الأساسي ولا يأتي مباشرة بعد الموضوع.
low.back: "My sister" is a single person (third‑person singular pronoun) → he. I go with myself only; goes with you, we, they and plural nouns; be is the basic form and does not come directly after the subject.
low.why: Mistranslates 'is' as 'he' and 'am' as 'I go'.

low.vi: My uncle = he (ngôi thứ ba số ít) → live + s = lives.
low.en: My uncle = he (third person singular) → live + s = lives.
low.l1: عمي = هو (ضمير الغائب) ← يعيش + s = يعيش.
low.back: My uncle = he (third‑person pronoun) ← lives + s = lives.
low.why: Confuses 'live' with 'lives' in explanation.

low.vi: Mệnh đề giới thiệu
low.en: Introductory clauses
low.l1: بنود تمهيدية
low.back: Preliminary items
low.why: Wrong term: 'items' instead of 'clauses'.

low.vi: Never đứng trước động từ thường: I never get up late. am never dùng khi sau đó là tính từ; never am và don't never sai.
low.en: Never goes before a main verb: I never get up late. Am never is used when an adjective follows; never am and don't never are wrong.
low.l1: لا يسبق الفعل الرئيسي أبدًا: لم أستيقظ متأخرًا أبدًا. لا يتم استخدام am أبدًا عندما تتبع الصفة؛ لا أكون أبدًا ولا أخطئ أبدًا.
low.back: The main verb is never preceded: لم أستيقظ متأخرًا أبدًا. "am" is never used when followed by an adjective; never be, never make a mistake.
low.why: Misinterprets 'don't never' as 'don't make a mistake'.

low.vi: Nghề nghiệp số ít cần a / an; engineer bắt đầu bằng âm nguyên âm → an engineer.
low.en: A singular job needs a / an; engineer starts with a vowel sound → an engineer.
low.l1: الوظيفة المفردة تحتاج إلى/an؛ يبدأ المهندس بصوت متحرك → مهندس.
low.back: The singular function needs to/an; the engineer starts with a moving voice → engineer.
low.why: Misleading translation of 'vowel sound' as 'moving voice'.

low.vi: Nghề nghiệp số ít cần a / an; engineer bắt đầu bằng âm nguyên âm → an.
low.en: A singular job needs a / an; engineer starts with a vowel sound → an.
low.l1: الوظيفة المفردة تحتاج إلى/an؛ يبدأ المهندس بصوت متحرك → an.
low.back: The singular noun needs a/an; the engineer begins with a vowel sound → an.
low.why: Wrong word 'engineer' instead of 'job'.

low.vi: Ngoại lệ: I am → câu hỏi đuôi là aren't I? "amn't I" và "am not I" không dùng; isn't it sai chủ ngữ.
low.en: Exception: I am → the tag is aren't I? We don't say "amn't I" or "am not I"; "isn't it" has the wrong subject.
low.l1: استثناء: أنا → العلامة أليس كذلك؟ نحن لا نقول "ألست أنا" أو "لست أنا"؛ "أليس كذلك" يحتوي على موضوع خاطئ.
low.back: Exception: I → the tag, isn’t it? We don’t say "Am I not" or "I am not"; "isn’t it" contains a wrong subject.
low.why: Wrong tag translation 'isn't it' instead of 'aren't I'.

low.vi: Nguyên âm o + y → chỉ thêm s: toys.
low.en: Vowel o + y → just add s: toys.
low.l1: حرف العلة o + y → فقط أضف s: اللعب.
low.back: Vowel o + y → just add s: اللعب.
low.why: Translates 'toys' as 'play' instead of 'toys'.

low.vi: Ngôn ngữ rào đón → may/might, tend to, it is likely that để tránh khẳng định tuyệt đối.
low.en: Hedging language → may/might, tend to, it is likely that to avoid absolute claims.
low.l1: لغة التحوط → قد / قد تميل إلى ذلك، فمن المحتمل تجنب المطالبات المطلقة.
low.back: Hedging language → may / might tend to that, likely to avoid absolute claims.
low.why: Grammatically broken and confusing translation of the hedging examples.

low.vi: Nobody mang nghĩa phủ định → đuôi khẳng định, dùng they. "didn't they" sai vì nobody đã phủ định; "did he" sai chủ ngữ; "noticed they" sai cấu trúc.
low.en: Nobody is negative in meaning → positive tag with they. "didn't they" is wrong because nobody is already negative; "did he" has the wrong subject; "noticed they" has the wrong structure.
low.l1: لا أحد سلبي في المعنى → علامة إيجابية معهم. "ألم يفعلوا" خطأ لأن لا أحد سلبي بالفعل؛ "هل هو" لديه موضوع خاطئ؛ "لاحظوا" أن لها بنية خاطئة.
low.back: No one is negative in meaning → a positive sign with them. "Did they not" is wrong because no one is actually negative; "Is he" has an incorrect subject; "Notice" that it has an incorrect construction.
low.why: Translates English grammar terms into Arabic, violating the 'stay in English' rule.

low.vi: Nowhere + be + there → is there. there is giữ trật tự thường; does there và has there sai trợ động từ.
low.en: Nowhere + be + there → is there. There is keeps normal word order; does there and has there use the wrong auxiliary.
low.l1: لا مكان + يكون + هناك → هناك. هناك يحافظ على ترتيب الكلمات الطبيعي؛ هل هناك وهل هناك استخدام مساعد خاطئ.
low.back: No place + be + there → there. There maintains the natural word order; is there and is there a wrong auxiliary usage.
low.why: Confuses 'is there' with 'does/has there' in Arabic.

low.vi: Nói hướng thay đổi (rose), tốc độ (sharply hay slowly) và mức thay đổi (by ten percent). ‘Rise’ không có tân ngữ, còn ‘raise’ thì có.
low.en: Say the direction (rose), the speed (sharply or slowly) and the size (by ten percent). 'Rise' has no object; 'raise' does.
low.l1: قل الاتجاه (الارتفاع)، والسرعة (بشكل حاد أو بطيء) والحجم (بنسبة عشرة بالمائة). "الصعود" ليس له أي غرض؛ "رفع" يفعل.
low.back: State the direction (rise), the speed (sharp or slow) and the magnitude (by ten percent). "Climb" has no purpose; "raise" does.
low.why: Translates 'object' as 'purpose' and 'rise' as 'climb'.

low.vi: Nói tuổi: be + số + years old → She is 25 years old. has là sai động từ; câu thứ ba thiếu be; are không đi với she.
low.en: Age: be + number + years old → She is 25 years old. Has is the wrong verb, the third sentence is missing be, and are doesn't go with she.
low.l1: العمر: يكون + الرقم + سنة → عمرها 25 سنة. Has هو الفعل الخاطئ، والجملة الثالثة مفقودة، ولا تتناسب مع she.
low.back: Age: be + number + year → She is 25 years old. Has is the wrong verb, the third sentence is missing, and it doesn't fit with she.
low.why: Omits 'be' in the error description for the third sentence.

low.vi: Nơi chốn + động từ chính quá khứ hung + S.
low.en: Place + main verb in the past (hung) + S.
low.l1: مكان + الفعل الرئيسي في الماضي (علق) + S.
low.back: Place + main verb in past (comment) + S.
low.why: Arabic gloss 'علق' means 'comment', not 'hung'.

low.vi: Nối hai động từ cùng chủ ngữ bằng and; cả hai đều thêm -s / -es. → Lan gets up early and goes jogging.
low.en: Join two verbs with the same subject using and; both take -s / -es. → Lan gets up early and goes jogging.
low.l1: قم بربط فعلين لهما نفس الموضوع باستخدام و؛ كلاهما يأخذ -s / -es. → يستيقظ لان مبكرًا ويذهب للركض.
low.back: Connect two verbs with the same subject using and; both take -s / -es. → He wakes up early and goes running.
low.why: Example sentence translated to Arabic, violating English retention rule.

low.vi: Phần nào sai? "I haven't (A) seen that film. – So (B) have (C) I (D)."
low.en: Which part is wrong? "I haven't (A) seen that film. – So (B) have (C) I (D)."
low.l1: أي جزء هو الخطأ؟ "لم أشاهد (أ) هذا الفيلم. - إذن (ب) لديه (ج) أنا (د)."
low.back: Which part is wrong? "I didn't watch (A) this movie. - So (B) he has (C) I (D)."
low.why: Example sentence mistranslated; 'So have I' becomes 'So he has I'.

low.vi: Phần nào sai? "My brother (A) and I (B) is (C) at the cinema (D)."
low.en: Which part is wrong? "My brother (A) and I (B) is (C) at the cinema (D)."
low.l1: أي جزء هو الخطأ؟ "أخي (أ) وأنا (ب) موجود (ج) في السينما (د)."
low.back: Which part is wrong? "My brother (A) and I (B) am (C) at the cinema (D)."
low.why: Arabic 'موجود' implies 'am', changing the error from 'is'.

low.vi: Phần nào sai? "Rarely (A) did (B) she (C) complained (D)."
low.en: Which part is wrong? "Rarely (A) did (B) she (C) complained (D)."
low.l1: أي جزء هو الخطأ؟ "نادرًا ما فعلت (أ) (ب) اشتكت (ج) (د)."
low.back: Which part is wrong? "I rarely did (A) (B) complained (C) (D)."
low.why: Example sentence mistranslated; 'she' becomes 'I' and word order is lost.

low.vi: Phần nào sai? "There are (A) five box (B) on the table (C) in the kitchen (D)."
low.en: Which part is wrong? "There are (A) five box (B) on the table (C) in the kitchen (D)."
low.l1: أي جزء هو الخطأ؟ "يوجد (أ) خمسة صناديق (ب) على الطاولة (ج) في المطبخ (د)."
low.back: Which part is wrong? "There are (A) five boxes (B) on the table (C) in the kitchen (D)."
low.why: Arabic 'صناديق' is plural, masking the singular error 'box'.

low.vi: Phần nào sai? "Two woman (A) are waiting (B) for the bus (C) outside the school (D)."
low.en: Which part is wrong? "Two woman (A) are waiting (B) for the bus (C) outside the school (D)."
low.l1: أي جزء هو الخطأ؟ "امرأتان (أ) تنتظران (ب) الحافلة (ج) خارج المدرسة (د)."
low.back: Which part is wrong? "Two women (A) are waiting (B) the bus (C) outside the school (D)."
low.why: Example sentence mistranslated; 'Two woman' becomes 'Two women' (correcting the error).

low.vi: Phụ âm + y → -ies: studies. Câu hoàn chỉnh: He studies in the library after class.
low.en: Consonant + y → -ies: studies. Complete sentence: He studies in the library after class.
low.l1: ساكن + y → -ies: دراسات. الجملة الكاملة: يدرس في المكتبة بعد الفصل.
low.back: Noun ending in y → -ies: studies. Full sentence: He studies in the library after class.
low.why: Example sentence translated to Arabic, violating English retention rule.

low.vi: Phụ âm b + y → ies: babies.
low.en: Consonant b + y → ies: babies.
low.l1: الحرف الساكن b + y → ies: الأطفال.
low.back: Consonant b + y → ies: children.
low.why: Example 'babies' mistranslated as 'children' (الأطفال) instead of 'babies'.

low.vi: Phủ định với I: am not (rút gọn I'm not; không có dạng amn't).
low.en: Negative with I: am not (short form I'm not – there is no "amn't").
low.l1: نفي مع I: لست (بصيغة مختصرة I'm not - لا يوجد "لست").
low.back: Negation with I: am not (short form I'm not – there is no "am not").
low.why: Translation of 'amn't' is wrong; should be 'amn't' not 'لست'.

low.vi: Phủ định với be: S + is + not → My phone is not on the desk. not phải đứng sau is; does not không đi với be; are không đi với my phone (số ít).
low.en: Negative with be: S + is + not → My phone is not on the desk. Not must come after is; does not doesn't go with be; are doesn't fit "my phone" (singular).
low.l1: سلبي مع be: S + is + not → هاتفي ليس على المكتب. لا يجب أن يأتي بعد ذلك؛ لا يذهب مع يكون؛ لا تناسب "هاتفي" (المفرد).
low.back: Negative with be: S + is + not → My phone is not on the desk. It should not come after that; it does not go with be; "my phone" (singular) does not fit.
low.why: Translation of 'Not must come after is' is completely wrong.

low.vi: Phủ định với we: are not, rút gọn aren't.
low.en: Negative with we: are not, short form aren't.
low.l1: سلبية مع نحن: ليست، صيغة قصيرة ليست كذلك.
low.back: Negation with we: not, the short form is not like that.
low.why: Wrong translation of 'aren't' as 'not like that'.

low.vi: Probably will → be likely to + V (bị động: to be finished). "tends to finish" mang nghĩa thói quen; "appears finishing" sai dạng; "likely finishing" sai dạng.
low.en: Probably will → be likely to + verb (passive: to be finished). "Tends to finish" describes a habit; "appears finishing" and "likely finishing" are the wrong forms.
low.l1: ربما سوف → من المرجح أن + الفعل (المبني للمجهول: على وشك الانتهاء). "يميل إلى الانتهاء" يصف عادة؛ "يبدو الانتهاء" و"التشطيب المحتمل" هما الأشكال الخاطئة.
low.back: Perhaps will → likely to + verb (passive: about to be finished). \"Tends to finish\" usually describes; \"seems to finish\" and \"potential finishing\" are the wrong forms.
low.why: English forms translated into Arabic incorrectly; passive form completely mistranslated.

low.vi: Sau did là nguyên mẫu: complain. Phần sai là (D).
low.en: After did, use the base form: complain. The wrong part is (D).
low.l1: بعد فعل ذلك، استخدم النموذج الأساسي: شكوى. الجزء الخطأ هو (د).
low.back: After doing that, use the base form: complain. The wrong part is (d).
low.why: Misinterprets 'did' as 'doing that' instead of auxiliary.

low.vi: Sau ‘What do you mean by’ đặt thẳng điều bạn hỏi, không thêm động từ ‘is’ mới.
low.en: After 'What do you mean by', put the thing, not a new verb 'is'.
low.l1: بعد "ماذا تقصد بـ"، ضع الشيء، وليس الفعل الجديد "هو".
low.back: After \"What do you mean by\", put the thing, not the new verb \"is\".
low.why: English target words 'What do you mean by' and 'is' translated to Arabic.

low.vi: Sau ‘Why don’t we’, ‘Shall we’ và ‘Let’s’ dùng động từ nguyên mẫu: Why don’t we go? Let’s go.
low.en: After 'Why don't we', 'Shall we' and 'Let's', use the base verb: Why don't we go? Let's go.
low.l1: بعد "لماذا لا نفعل"، "يجب علينا"، و"دعونا"، استخدم الفعل الأساسي: لماذا لا نذهب؟ دعنا نذهب.
low.back: After "why don’t we", "we should", and "let’s", use the base verb: why don’t we go? let’s go.
low.why: Translates 'Shall we' as 'we should', changing meaning.

low.vi: So + tính từ / Such + be + danh từ → be + S
low.en: So + adjective / Such + be + noun → be + S
low.l1: لذا + صفة / مثل + كن + اسم → كن + س
low.back: Thus + adjective / like + be + noun → be + s
low.why: Garbled translation; 'Such' as 'like', 'be' as 'kn', 'S' as 's'.

low.vi: Study tận cùng phụ âm + y → bỏ y, thêm -ies: studies. studyes và studys sai quy tắc; study thiếu -s vì my sister = she.
low.en: Study ends in consonant + y → drop the y and add -ies: studies. Studyes and studys break the rule; study is missing the -s because my sister = she.
low.l1: تنتهي الدراسة بالحرف الساكن + y → أسقط y وأضف -ies: دراسات. دراسات ودراسات تكسر القاعدة؛ الدراسة تفتقد حرف -s لأن أختي = هي.
low.back: Study ends with a consonant + y → drop y and add -ies: studies. Studies and studies break the rule; the study lacks the -s because my sister = she.
low.why: Translates 'study' as 'research' instead of the verb.

low.vi: Such was his anger… (be trước S).
low.en: Such was his anger… (be before S).
low.l1: هكذا كان غضبه... (يكون قبل ق).
low.back: Thus was his anger... (be before q).
low.why: Garbled translation; 'be' as 'kn', 'S' as 'q'.

low.vi: Số nhiều bất quy tắc: man → men.
low.en: Irregular plural: man → men.
low.l1: الجمع غير المنتظم: رجل → رجال.
low.back: Irregular plural: man → men.
low.why: English words man → men must stay in English unchanged.

low.vi: The data ___ to suggest that older drivers are safer. (khuynh hướng)
low.en: The data ___ to suggest that older drivers are safer. (a tendency)
low.l1: تشير البيانات ___ إلى أن السائقين الأكبر سنًا أكثر أمانًا. (ميل)
low.back: The data ___ indicate that older drivers are safer. (trend)
low.why: Translated 'suggest' into the main text, altering the fill-in sentence structure.

low.vi: These findings ___ indicate that sleep quality affects exam performance. (có thể – mức dè dặt)
low.en: These findings ___ indicate that sleep quality affects exam performance. (possibly – a tentative claim)
low.l1: تشير هذه النتائج ___ إلى أن جودة النوم تؤثر على أداء الامتحان. (ربما – مطالبة مبدئية)
low.back: These results ___ suggest that sleep quality affects exam performance. (perhaps – tentative claim)
low.why: Translated 'indicate' into the main sentence, ruining the blank structure.

low.vi: They đi với dạng nguyên mẫu have.
low.en: They takes the base form have.
low.l1: أنها تأخذ النموذج الأساسي لها.
low.back: It takes its basic form.
low.why: Missing 'have' in the translation.

low.vi: Tiếng Anh không dùng ‘resume’ để kết luận. Hãy dùng ‘to sum up’ hoặc ‘to summarise’.
low.en: 'Resume' is not used to conclude in English. Use 'to sum up' or 'to summarise'.
low.l1: لا يتم استخدام "السيرة الذاتية" في الختام باللغة الإنجليزية. استخدم "للتلخيص" أو "للتلخيص".
low.back: The term "CV" is not used in the closing in English. Use "to summarize" or "in summary".
low.why: Wrong word choice for 'Resume' (CV vs verb).

low.vi: Tiếng Việt hay bỏ "là" trước tính từ ("Tôi mệt"), nhưng tiếng Anh luôn cần be: I am tired, không nói I tired.
low.en: Many languages leave out a verb before adjectives, but English always needs be: say "I am tired", never "I tired".
low.l1: تتجاهل العديد من اللغات الفعل قبل الصفات، لكن اللغة الإنجليزية تحتاج دائمًا إلى أن تقول: "أنا متعب"، وليس "أنا متعب" أبدًا.
low.back: Many languages ignore the verb before adjectives, but English always needs you to say: "I am tired", not "I am tired" ever.
low.why: Example 'I am tired' repeated twice, failing to show the incorrect 'I tired'.

low.vi: Tom = he → get thêm -s: gets.
low.en: Tom = he → get takes -s: gets.
low.l1: توم = هو → الحصول على يأخذ -s: يحصل.
low.back: Tom = he → get takes -s: gets.
low.why: Literal translation of 'get' is unnatural.

low.vi: Tom là một người → is not = isn't. aren't dành cho số nhiều; not đứng một mình thì thiếu động từ; don't không dùng với be.
low.en: "Tom" is one person → is not = isn't. Aren't is for plurals; not on its own leaves the sentence without a verb; don't is never used with be.
low.l1: "توم" هو شخص واحد → ليس = ليس كذلك. ليست للجمع؛ وليس من تلقاء نفسه يترك الجملة بلا فعل؛ لا تستخدم أبدا مع be.
low.back: "Tom" is a single person → not = not so. Not for plural; and it does not by itself leave the sentence without a verb; never use with be.
low.why: Misleading translation of 'isn't' and 'not' as 'ليس'.

low.vi: Tomato thuộc nhóm -o thêm es: tomatoes.
low.en: Tomato is one of the -o words that add es: tomatoes.
low.l1: الطماطم هي إحدى الكلمات -o التي تضيف es: الطماطم.
low.back: Tomatoes are one of the -o words that add es: tomatoes.
low.why: Plural 'tomatoes' translated to Arabic instead of keeping English word.

low.vi: Trong IELTS Listening, thiếu đuôi -s ở đáp án số nhiều bị tính là SAI. Nghe kỹ âm cuối và kiểm lại xem chỗ trống cần một hay nhiều.
low.en: In IELTS Listening, a missing -s on a plural answer is marked WRONG. Listen carefully to the final sound and check whether the gap needs one thing or more than one.
low.l1: في اختبار IELTS للاستماع، يتم وضع علامة "خطأ" على علامة "-" المفقودة في إجابة الجمع. استمع جيدًا إلى الصوت النهائي وتحقق مما إذا كانت الفجوة تحتاج إلى شيء واحد أو أكثر.
low.back: In the IELTS listening test, a "mistake" mark is placed on the missing "-" in the plural answer. Listen carefully to the final audio and verify whether the gap needs one thing or more.
low.why: Misinterprets 'missing -s' as a missing dash.

low.vi: Trong Speaking, không cần dùng câu hỏi đuôi với giám khảo, nhưng câu trả lời ngắn + mở rộng (Yes, I do – actually I…) giúp mở đầu tự nhiên. Trong Listening Section 1, câu hỏi đuôi thường dùng để xác nhận thông tin – cẩn thận với đáp án bị sửa lại.
low.en: In Speaking you don't need question tags with the examiner, but a short answer plus more detail ("Yes, I do – actually, I…") is a natural way to start. In Listening Section 1, tags are often used to confirm details – watch out for answers that get corrected.
low.l1: في المحادثة، لا تحتاج إلى علامات استفهام مع الممتحن، ولكن الإجابة القصيرة بالإضافة إلى المزيد من التفاصيل ("نعم، أفعل - في الواقع، أنا...") هي طريقة طبيعية للبدء. في قسم الاستماع 1، غالبًا ما تُستخدم العلامات لتأكيد التفاصيل - انتبه للإجابات التي يتم تصحيحها.
low.back: In conversation, you don't need question marks with the examiner, but a short answer plus more detail (\"yes, I do - actually, I ...\") is a natural way to start. In Listening Section 1, markers are often used to confirm details - watch out for answers that are corrected.
low.why: 'Question tags' mistranslated as 'question marks'.

low.vi: Trong câu hỏi, trợ động từ ‘don’t’ đứng trước ‘we’.
low.en: In a question, the helper verb 'don't' comes before 'we'.
low.l1: في السؤال يأتي الفعل المساعد "لا" قبل "نحن".
low.back: In the question, the auxiliary verb "لا" comes before "we".
low.why: Translates 'don't' as 'لا' instead of keeping the English form.

low.vi: Trong giao tiếp thân mật có thể nói Me too / Me neither thay cho So do I / Neither do I.
low.en: In casual conversation you can say "Me too" / "Me neither" instead of "So do I" / "Neither do I".
low.l1: في المحادثة غير الرسمية، يمكنك أن تقول "أنا أيضًا" أو "أنا أيضًا" بدلاً من "أنا أيضًا" أو "ولا أنا".
low.back: In informal conversation, you can say \"I also\" or \"me too\" instead of \"I also\" or \"not me\".
low.why: English examples replaced with Arabic, violating format rules.

low.vi: Trạng từ tần suất đứng trước động từ thường goes. → never.
low.en: A frequency adverb goes before the main verb goes. → never.
low.l1: ظرف التردد يذهب قبل أن يذهب الفعل الرئيسي. → أبدا.
low.back: The adverb of frequency goes before the main verb. → never.
low.why: Literal translation of 'goes' makes it nonsensical.

low.vi: Trạng từ đứng trước động từ, và she cần goes.
low.en: The adverb goes before the verb, and she needs goes.
low.l1: يأتي الظرف قبل الفعل، وتحتاج إلى الذهاب.
low.back: The adverb comes before the verb, and you need to go.
low.why: 'goes' mistranslated as 'to go', losing grammar point.

low.vi: Trả lời ngắn khẳng định không rút gọn → Yes, I am. Dạng rút gọn 'm không đứng cuối câu; are và is không đi với I.
low.en: A positive short answer is never contracted → Yes, I am. The short form 'm can't end a sentence, and are and is don't go with I.
low.l1: الإجابة القصيرة الإيجابية لا يتم التعاقد عليها مطلقًا → نعم، أنا كذلك. لا يمكن للصيغة القصيرة "m" إنهاء الجملة، كما أنها لا تتوافق مع I.
low.back: The short positive answer is never contracted → yes, I am. The short form "m" cannot end the sentence, and it does not agree with I.
low.why: Misinterprets 'are/is don't go with I' as agreement.

low.vi: Trả lời ngắn: Yes / No + S + be
low.en: Short answer: Yes / No + S + be
low.l1: الإجابة المختصرة: نعم / لا + س + كن
low.back: Short answer: yes / no + will + be
low.why: 'be' mistranslated as 'will'.

low.vi: Tận cùng -x → thêm es: boxes.
low.en: Ending in -x → add es: boxes.
low.l1: تنتهي بـ -x → أضف es: صناديق.
low.back: Ends with -x → add es: boxes.
low.why: Boxes was translated to صناديق instead of keeping the English example.

low.vi: Tận cùng ch → thêm -es: watches.
low.en: Ending in ch → add -es: watches.
low.l1: تنتهي بـ ch → add -es: الساعات.
low.back: Ends with ch → add -es: hours.
low.why: English example word 'watches' was wrongly translated instead of kept in English.

low.vi: Từ hai trở lên → danh từ thêm s: sisters.
low.en: Two or more → the noun takes s: sisters.
low.l1: اثنان أو أكثر → الاسم يأخذ s: الأخوات.
low.back: Two or more → the noun takes s: sisters.
low.why: English example word 'sisters' was wrongly translated into Arabic.

low.vi: Uniform đọc /ˈjuː-/ – âm đầu là phụ âm /j/ → a.
low.en: Uniform is pronounced /ˈjuː-/ – it starts with the consonant sound /j/ → a.
low.l1: يتم نطق الزي الموحد /ˈjuː-/ - ويبدأ بالصوت الساكن /j/ → a.
low.back: The uniform prefix is pronounced /ˈjuː-/ - and starts with the consonant sound /j/ → a.
low.why: The target English word 'Uniform' was translated into Arabic instead of kept.

low.vi: an + danh từ số ít (âm đầu là nguyên âm)
low.en: an + singular noun (starts with a vowel sound)
low.l1: + اسم مفرد (يبدأ بحرف متحرك)
low.back: + singular noun (starts with a vowel letter)
low.why: Missing 'an' at start; vowel sound translated as vowel letter.

low.vi: appear + to V là cách nói dè dặt (có vẻ). "is certainly" và "always is" khẳng định tuyệt đối; "definitely seems" đúng ngữ pháp nhưng definitely làm mất tính rào đón.
low.en: appear + to + verb is a cautious way to say "seems". "Is certainly" and "always is" are absolute; "definitely seems" is grammatical, but definitely cancels out the hedge.
low.l1: الظهور + to + الفعل هو طريقة حذرة لقول "يبدو". "هو بالتأكيد" و"يوجد دائمًا" مطلقان؛ "يبدو بالتأكيد" هو أمر نحوي، لكنه يلغي التحوط بالتأكيد.
low.back: appearance + to + verb is a cautious way to say "seems". "He certainly" and "there is always" are absolute; "certainly seems" is grammatical, but it negates the cautiousness of certainly.
low.why: Translates 'appear' as 'الظهور' (noun) instead of verb; 'Is certainly' mistranslated.

low.vi: appear + to be + tính từ (dường như…) là cách rào đón trang trọng.
low.en: appear + to be + adjective (= seems…) is a formal hedge.
low.l1: يبدو + أن يكون + الصفة (= يبدو…) تحوط شكلي.
low.back: Seems + to be + adjective (= seems…) encloses a form.
low.why: Arabic translation of 'hedge' is incorrect and confusing.

low.vi: as + does + S (trang trọng). → She speaks French fluently, as does her sister.
low.en: as + does + S (formal). → She speaks French fluently, as does her sister.
low.l1: كما يفعل + + S (رسمي). → تتحدث الفرنسية بطلاقة، كما تفعل أختها.
low.back: as does + + S (formal). → You speak French fluently, as does your sister.
low.why: Translates 'as does' as 'كما يفعل' (verb) instead of keeping structure; example changed.

low.vi: be (hoặc trợ động từ) trước S
low.en: be (or an auxiliary) before S
low.l1: يكون (أو مساعدًا) قبل S
low.back: Be (or auxiliary) before S
low.why: Verb 'be' translated as conjugated verb instead of keeping English base.

low.vi: be likely + to V (có khả năng sẽ…) → are likely to rise. rose, rising, rise không đi sau be likely.
low.en: be likely + to + verb (= will probably…) → are likely to rise. Rose, rising and rise can't follow "be likely".
low.l1: من المحتمل + إلى + فعل (= سوف على الأرجح...) → من المرجح أن يرتفع. روز، والصعود، والصعود لا يمكن أن يتبعا "محتمل".
low.back: likely + to + verb (= will probably...) → likely to rise. Rose, and the ascent, and the ascent cannot follow "likely".
low.why: Translates 'Rose' (verb form) as 'روز' (name); 'rising' as 'الصعود' (noun).

low.vi: can be + for some students giới hạn phạm vi khẳng định. always và must khẳng định tuyệt đối, không thận trọng hơn câu gốc.
low.en: "Can be" + "for some students" limits the scope of the claim. Always and must are absolute, so they are no more cautious than the original.
low.l1: "يمكن" + "لبعض الطلاب" يحد من نطاق المطالبة. دائما ويجب أن تكون مطلقة، لذلك فهي ليست أكثر حذرا من الأصل.
low.back: "can" + "for some students" limits the scope of the claim. It should always be absolute, therefore it is not more cautious than the original.
low.why: Key English target words translated; 'claim' translated as legal claim.

low.vi: indicate (cho thấy) là động từ báo cáo dè dặt. Các phương án còn lại khẳng định tuyệt đối, không phù hợp với văn học thuật thận trọng.
low.en: Indicate is a cautious reporting verb. The other options make absolute claims, which don't suit cautious academic writing.
low.l1: الإشارة هي فعل إبلاغ حذر. الخيارات الأخرى تقدم ادعاءات مطلقة، والتي لا تناسب الكتابة الأكاديمية الحذرة.
low.back: The reference is a cautious reporting verb. The other options present absolute claims, which do not suit cautious academic writing.
low.why: Target verb 'indicate' mistranslated as a noun 'الإشارة'.

low.vi: may be + V3 kết hợp partly tạo kết luận dè dặt. "is surely", "must always be", "is completely" quá chắc chắn và mâu thuẫn với partly (một phần).
low.en: "May be" + past participle together with partly makes a tentative conclusion. "Is surely", "must always be" and "is completely" are too certain and contradict partly.
low.l1: "قد يكون" + النعت الماضي ويصل جزئيًا إلى نتيجة مبدئية. "هل بالتأكيد" و"يجب أن يكون دائمًا" و"هو تمامًا" مؤكدة للغاية ومتناقضة جزئيًا.
low.back: "might be" + past participle and reaches partially a preliminary result. "Is certainly" and "must always be" and "is exactly" are highly certain and partially contradictory.
low.why: Mistranslates 'partly' as 'يصل جزئيًا' (reaches partially); 'Is surely' as 'هل'.

low.vi: phụ âm + y → ies
low.en: consonant + y → ies
low.l1: ساكن + ص → ies
low.back: Resident + adj → ies
low.why: Arabic letter 'ص' is wrong for English 'y'.

low.vi: seem + to V; và "prove" quá chắc chắn, mâu thuẫn với "seem". Dùng: seem to suggest.
low.en: seem + to + verb; "prove" is too certain and contradicts "seem". Use: seem to suggest.
low.l1: يبدو + إلى + فعل؛ "يثبت" مؤكد للغاية ويتناقض مع "يبدو". الاستخدام: يبدو أنه يوحي.
low.back: seems + to + verb; "يثبت" is too definite and contradicts "seems". Usage: it seems that it suggests.
low.why: English target words translated into Arabic, ruining grammar rule explanation.

low.vi: seem + to be + tính từ (dường như…) → seem to be less willing. "seem be" thiếu to; "are seem" sai vì seem đã là động từ chính.
low.en: seem + to be + adjective (= appears to be…) → seem to be less willing. "Seem be" is missing to; "are seem" is wrong because seem is already the main verb.
low.l1: يبدو + أن يكون + صفة (= يبدو أن...) → يبدو أقل استعدادا. "يبدو" مفقود ل؛ "are يبدو" خطأ لأن يبدو هو الفعل الرئيسي بالفعل.
low.back: seems + to be + adjective (= seems that...) → seems less prepared. "Seems" missing l; "are seems" is wrong because seems is already the main verb.
low.why: Translates 'to' as 'ل' (for); 'Seem be' explanation is garbled.

low.vi: tend to + V làm nhận định bớt tuyệt đối.
low.en: tend to + verb makes the claim less absolute.
low.l1: تميل إلى + الفعل يجعل المطالبة أقل مطلقة.
low.back: tends to + verb makes the claim less absolute.
low.why: Ungrammatical Arabic (أقل مطلقة) and 'tend to' translated as feminine verb.

low.vi: tend to + V nguyên mẫu (to ở đây là một phần của động từ nguyên mẫu, không phải giới từ).
low.en: tend to + base verb (here to is part of the infinitive, not a preposition).
low.l1: تميل إلى + الفعل الأساسي (هنا جزء من صيغة المصدر، وليس حرف الجر).
low.back: tends to + base verb (here part of the infinitive form, not a preposition).
low.why: English keywords 'tend to' translated into Arabic verb form.

low.vi: tend to + V, chủ ngữ Men số nhiều → tend. tending thiếu động từ chính; "are tend" sai; tends chia số ít.
low.en: tend to + verb, and "Men" is plural → tend. "Tending" leaves no main verb; "are tend" is wrong; "tends" is singular.
low.l1: تميل إلى + فعل، و"الرجال" جمع → يميل. "الاهتمام" لا يترك أي فعل رئيسي؛ "تميل" خطأ؛ "يميل" مفرد.
low.back: tends to + verb, and "men" is plural → tends. "interest" does not leave any main verb; "tends" is wrong; "tends" singular.
low.why: Wrong verb forms and confusing translation of 'tending'.

low.vi: tend/seem/appear + to V để làm nhẹ mức khẳng định; data có thể coi là số ít (tends) hoặc số nhiều trong văn học thuật (tend).
low.en: tend/seem/appear + to + verb softens a claim; in academic writing, data can be treated as singular (tends) or plural (tend).
low.l1: تميل/تبدو/تظهر + to + فعل يخفف من المطالبة؛ في الكتابة الأكاديمية، يمكن التعامل مع البيانات على أنها مفرد (اتجاهات) أو جمع (اتجاه).
low.back: tends/appears/shows + to + verb mitigates the claim; in academic writing, data can be treated as singular (trend) or plural (trends).
low.why: Confuses 'data' with 'trend' in parentheses.

low.vi: there giữ nguyên
low.en: there stays there
low.l1: هناك يبقى هناك
low.back: There stays there.
low.why: Grammar rule translated literally; English grammatical 'there' should remain in English.

low.vi: Đuôi luôn dùng ĐẠI TỪ: this/that → it, these/those → they, nobody → they
low.en: Tags always use a PRONOUN: this/that → it, these/those → they, nobody → they
low.l1: تستخدم العلامات دائمًا ضميرًا: هذا/هذا → هذا، هؤلاء/أولئك → هم، لا أحد → هم
low.back: markers always use a pronoun: this/this → this, these/those → they, no one → they
low.why: Translates 'this/that' incorrectly as 'this/this'.

low.vi: Đuôi số nhiều phải đọc thành tiếng: books /s/, dogs /z/, buses /ɪz/. Nuốt mất âm cuối thì người nghe tưởng bạn nói số ít.
low.en: Say the plural ending out loud: books /s/, dogs /z/, buses /ɪz/. If you swallow the last sound, listeners will think you said the singular.
low.l1: انطق صيغة الجمع بصوت عالٍ: الكتب /s/، الكلاب /z/، الحافلات /ɪz/. إذا ابتلعت الصوت الأخير، فسيعتقد المستمعون أنك قلت المفرد.
low.back: Pronounce the plural loudly: books /s/, dogs /z/, buses /ɪz/. If you swallow the final sound, listeners will think you said the singular.
low.why: English example words (books, dogs, buses) were translated instead of kept unchanged.

low.vi: Đánh cả hàm răng → số nhiều bất quy tắc teeth. tooth là một chiếc răng; tooths và teeths không tồn tại.
low.en: A whole set of teeth → the irregular plural teeth. Tooth means one tooth; tooths and teeths don't exist.
low.l1: مجموعة كاملة من الأسنان → مجموعة الأسنان غير المنتظمة. السن يعني سن واحد؛ الأسنان والأسنان غير موجودة.
low.back: a full set of teeth → irregular set of teeth. tooth means a single tooth; teeth and teeth do not exist.
low.why: Confuses 'irregular plural' with 'irregular set of teeth'.

low.vi: Đảo nơi chốn là đảo động từ chính (không có do). Do chỉ xuất hiện với trạng từ phủ định: Never did he return.
low.en: Inversion after a place adverbial moves the main verb (there is no do). Do only appears with negative adverbs: Never did he return.
low.l1: الانقلاب بعد مكان الظرف يحرك الفعل الرئيسي (لا يوجد فعل). لا يظهر إلا مع الظروف السلبية: لم يعد أبدًا.
low.back: Inversion after the adverbial position moves the main verb (no verb). It appears only with negative adverbs: never again.
low.why: Misinterprets 'no do' as 'no verb' and mistranslates example.

low.vi: Đảo sau Nowhere / Not once / On no account
low.en: Inversion after Nowhere / Not once / On no account
low.l1: الانقلاب بعد لا مكان / ليس مرة واحدة / بدون حساب
low.back: the flip after no place / not once / without counting
low.why: Mistranslates 'On no account' as 'without counting'.

low.vi: Đồng ý có kèm điều kiện
low.en: Agreeing with reservations
low.l1: الموافقة على التحفظات
low.back: Agreeing to reservations
low.why: Mistranslates 'with reservations' as 'agreeing to reservations' instead of 'مع تحفظات'.

low.vi: Đồng ý với câu khẳng định thì quá khứ (passed) → So did I. "So I did" sai trật tự; Neither dùng cho câu phủ định; "So was I" sai trợ động từ.
low.en: Agreeing with a positive past statement (passed) → So did I. "So I did" has the wrong word order; Neither is for negative statements; "So was I" uses the wrong auxiliary.
low.l1: الموافقة على عبارة ماضية إيجابية (تم النجاح) → وكذلك فعلت أنا. "وهكذا فعلت" بها ترتيب خاطئ للكلمات؛ ولا يتعلق الأمر بالتصريحات السلبية. "وهكذا كنت" تستخدم أداة مساعدة خاطئة.
low.back: Agreeing to a positive past statement (was successful) → and so did I. "And so I did" has incorrect word order; and it does not concern negative statements. "And so I was" uses the wrong auxiliary verb.
low.why: Translates grammar tokens literally into Arabic instead of keeping English forms.

low.vi: Đồng ý với câu phủ định (haven't) → Neither have I, nên phần sai là (B) So. I haven't, have, I đều đúng.
low.en: Agreeing with a negative statement (haven't) → Neither have I, so (B) So is wrong. "I haven't", "have" and "I" are all correct.
low.l1: الموافقة على العبارة السلبية (لم أفعل) ← ولا أنا، لذا (ب) هذا خطأ. "ليس لدي" و"لدي" و"أنا" كلها صحيحة.
low.back: Agreeing to the negative phrase (I didn't) ← not me, so (b) this is wrong. "I don't have" and "I have" and "I am" are all correct.
low.why: Translates 'I haven't' as 'I don't have', changing meaning.

low.vi: Đồng ý với câu phủ định dùng Neither.
low.en: To agree with a negative statement, use Neither.
low.l1: للموافقة على عبارة سلبية، استخدم لا.
low.back: To agree with a negative statement, use no.
low.why: Wrong word: 'لا' means 'no', not 'Neither'.

low.vi: Đồng điệu với and: so + be + S → so is her brother. as is dùng sau dấu phẩy mà không có and; so does cần động từ thường; is so sai trật tự.
low.en: Agreeing with and: so + be + S → so is her brother. As is is used after a comma without and; so does needs a main verb; is so has the wrong word order.
low.l1: متفقة مع و: هكذا + كن + س → كذلك أخوها. كما يتم استخدامه بعد الفاصلة بدون و؛ وكذلك الأمر يحتاج إلى فعل رئيسي؛ هو كذلك ترتيب الكلمات الخاطئ.
low.back: Agree with and: like this + be + s → likewise her brother. It is also used after a comma without and; likewise the matter needs a main verb; it is also the wrong word order.
low.why: Translates 'so is her brother' as 'likewise her brother', losing grammar.

low.vi: Động từ khuyết thiếu
low.en: Modal verbs
low.l1: الأفعال الشرطية
low.back: Conditional verbs
low.why: 'Modal verbs' are الأفعال الناقصة/المساعدة, not conditional verbs (الشرطية).

low.vi: Động từ khuyết thiếu may + V nguyên mẫu → may be (có thể là), dùng để rào đón. "may been", "may being", "may to be" đều sai dạng sau may.
low.en: Modal may + base verb → may be (= might be), used to hedge. "May been", "may being" and "may to be" are all the wrong form after may.
low.l1: Modal may + الفعل الأساسي → may be (= may be)، يستخدم للتحوط. "May be" و"may be" و"may to be" كلها أشكال خاطئة بعد may.
low.back: Modal may + base verb → may be (= may be), used for hedging. "May be" and "may be" and "may to be" are all incorrect forms after may.
low.why: Wrong English examples; 'May been' changed to 'May be'.

low.vi: động từ chính trước S; KHÔNG dùng do; S là đại từ thì không đảo
low.en: main verb before S; NO do; if S is a pronoun, no inversion
low.l1: الفعل الرئيسي قبل S؛ لا تفعل؛ إذا كان S ضميرًا، فلا يوجد انعكاس
low.back: The main verb before S; do not do; if S is a pronoun, there is no reflexive.
low.why: Translates 'NO do' as 'do not do', confusing the rule.

low.vi: Ở đây ‘reserve’ là động từ, và ‘I want’ nghe quá thẳng khi nói chuyện điện thoại.
low.en: 'Reserve' is a verb here, and 'I want' sounds too direct on the phone.
low.l1: كلمة "احتياطي" هي فعل هنا، وكلمة "أريد" تبدو مباشرة جدًا على الهاتف.
low.back: The word "reserve" is a verb here, and the word "I want" sounds too direct on the phone.
low.why: Wrong translation; 'Reserve' translated as 'reserve' (noun) not verb.

low.vi: ‘Advice’ không có số nhiều. Nói ‘some advice’ hoặc ‘a piece of advice’, không bao giờ nói ‘advices’.
low.en: 'Advice' has no plural. Say 'some advice' or 'a piece of advice', never 'advices'.
low.l1: "النصيحة" ليس لها جمع. قل "بعض النصائح" أو "نصيحة"، وليس "نصائح" أبدًا.
low.back: "Advice" has no plural. Say "some advice" or "advice", never "advices".
low.why: Translates 'a piece of advice' as just 'advice', losing detail.

low.vi: ‘Advice’ là danh từ còn ‘advise’ là động từ. Nói ‘give advice’ hoặc ‘advise me’.
low.en: 'Advice' is a noun, and 'advise' is the verb. Say 'give advice' or 'advise me'.
low.l1: "النصيحة" اسم، و "المشورة" هو الفعل. قل "أعطني نصيحة" أو "انصحني".
low.back: "Advice" is a noun, and "consult" is the verb. Say "Give me advice" or "Advise me".
low.why: Wrong word: 'المشورة' is a noun, not the verb 'advise'.

low.vi: ‘Against’ không đi với ‘with’ và nghe rất gay gắt khi tranh luận. Dùng ‘not convinced’ để nói nhẹ nhàng và chính xác hơn.
low.en: 'Against' does not take 'with', and it sounds extreme in a debate. Use 'not convinced' for a softer, more precise statement.
low.l1: كلمة "ضد" لا تعني "مع"، وهي تبدو متطرفة في النقاش. استخدم "غير مقتنع" للحصول على عبارة أكثر ليونة ودقة.
low.back: The word "against" does not mean "with", and it appears extreme in a discussion. Use "unconvinced" to get a softer and more precise phrase.
low.why: 'does not take with' mistranslated as 'لا تعني مع' (does not mean).

low.vi: ‘Agree’ là động từ nên phủ định bằng ‘don’t’: ‘I don’t agree’.
low.en: 'Agree' is a verb, so make it negative with 'don't'.
low.l1: "أوافق" هو ​​فعل، لذا اجعله منفيًا بـ "لا تفعل".
low.back: "I agree" is a verb, so make it negative with "do not".
low.why: Translates 'don't' as 'do not', which is a verb, not a negative marker.

low.vi: ‘Apologise’ là động từ nên không dùng ‘am’ trước nó.
low.en: 'Apologise' is a verb, so do not use 'am' before it.
low.l1: "الاعتذار" هو فعل، لذا لا تستخدم "am" قبله.
low.back: "Apology" is a verb, so do not use "am" before it.
low.why: Wrong word: 'الاعتذار' is a noun, not the verb 'apologise'.

low.vi: ‘Bye’ thân thiện và an toàn trong hầu hết tình huống hằng ngày. ‘Goodbye’ nghe trang trọng và có phần dứt khoát hơn.
low.en: 'Bye' is friendly and safe in almost every everyday situation. 'Goodbye' sounds slightly more final or polite.
low.l1: كلمة "وداعا" ودية وآمنة في كل المواقف اليومية تقريبًا. تبدو كلمة "وداعا" أكثر نهائية أو مهذبة قليلاً.
low.back: The word "goodbye" is friendly and safe in almost all everyday situations. The word "goodbye" seems more final or slightly more polite.
low.why: Both quotes translated as 'goodbye', losing the 'Bye' distinction.

low.vi: ‘Cancel’ nghĩa là hủy hẳn. Muốn đổi ngày thì dùng ‘move’ hoặc ‘change’.
low.en: 'Cancel' means stop it completely. To change the day, use 'move' or 'change'.
low.l1: ""إلغاء"" يعني إيقافه تمامًا. لتغيير اليوم، استخدم "نقل" أو "تغيير".
low.back: \"\"إلغاء\"\" means stop it completely. To change the day, use \"نقل\" or \"تغيير\".
low.why: Arabic words used instead of required English terms 'move' and 'change'.

low.vi: ‘Finish’ nghe như kết thúc một công việc. Hãy nói ‘I should get going’ hoặc ‘I have to go’.
low.en: 'Finish' sounds like ending a task. Use 'I should get going' or 'I have to go'.
low.l1: تبدو كلمة "إنهاء" بمثابة إنهاء مهمة. استخدم "يجب أن أذهب" أو "يجب أن أذهب".
low.back: The word "finish" sounds like finishing a task. Use "I have to go" or "I must go".
low.why: Both English examples translated identically, losing 'I should get going'.

low.vi: ‘Good night’ chỉ dùng khi chia tay hoặc đi ngủ, không dùng để chào lúc gặp.
low.en: Use 'good night' only when leaving or going to sleep.
low.l1: استخدم "ليلة سعيدة" فقط عند المغادرة أو النوم.
low.back: Use \"Good night\" only when leaving or sleeping.
low.why: Arabic translation used instead of required English phrase 'good night'.

low.vi: ‘I like’ nói về sở thích chung; để nhận lời mời hãy dùng ‘I would love to’.
low.en: 'I like' talks about general hobbies; use 'I would love to' to accept an offer.
low.l1: كلمة "أحب" تتحدث عن الهوايات العامة؛ استخدم "أود أن" لقبول العرض.
low.back: The word "love" talks about general hobbies; use "I would like to" to accept an offer.
low.why: Translates 'I like' as 'love' and 'I would love to' as 'I would like to'.
